explanation: A large farm or estate where grapes are grown for wine production, here symbolizing God's kingdom.
People hired to perform physical labor in the vineyard, representing those who serve God through faith and deeds.
The fixed payment a worker receives after a full day of work, often measured as one denarius (a Roman coin).
One of the key concepts in the chapter referring to positions of honor and authority; Jesus uses this to show that leadership is about service.
People who carry out tasks on behalf of others, a central theme where Jesus teaches that the greatest must be servant to all.
The instrument with which Jesus will be executed; it symbolizes suffering and sacrifice as the path to honor in God's kingdom.
